text:
sophie: quick sync — proposing a tiny RBAC tweak so the event-relay can read keystore metadata for observability. needs fast review because it touches KMS audit and our SAST gate.
lin: do we absolutely need the change now? what's the blast radius if misconfigured? :slightly_frowning_face:
sophie: minimal: `keystore.events.read` only, constrained to resource attrs env=staging-canary and tag=relay. no key material, only headers + metadata.
james: SAST just flagged a risky serializer pattern in relay that could include env-injected strings. scan id 9002. we should patch serializer before broad rollout.
security-bot: SAST alert: rule 'unsafe-serialize' at repo redwood/relay src/serialize.js:120. https://scans.internal/9002
lin: ok. concrete plan?
sophie: 1) immediate: grant scoped RBAC to canary relay svcacct + enable audit-only mode for 1h. 2) concurrently: patch serializer to whitelist fields and add unit + e2e redaction tests. 3) follow-up: add pre-merge SAST block and a staging DAST probe that asserts no secrets in emitted events.
james: for the audit-only smoke test, use this query and redact-check snippet: `gcloud logging read "jsonPayload.stream=\"keystore-events\" AND resource.labels.env=\"staging-canary\"" --limit 200 | jq -r '.jsonPayload|@json' | grep -E "(secret|password|private_key)"`.
lin: also include KMS key access audit: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:\"cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.access\"" --project=redwood-kms --limit 50`.
oncall: rollback play if leak detected: revoke svcacct binding, scale relay to 0, open INC-2001, collect last 2k events for forensic review. owners: @sophie (postmortem), @lin (rollback).
sophie: i'll open the PR with RBAC change + link to serializer fix. james — can you prioritize SAST suppress/review if we need temporary suppression? please attach unit test evidence.
james: will prioritize. suppression only if tests prove redaction and code change lands in same PR.
security-bot: Reminder: attach KMS audit export and the audit-log smoke output to the PR. retention note: KMS logs 120 days.
lin: canary deploy scheduled in 90m. i'll post audit output in this thread.
sophie: thanks — if audit shows any match we abort immediately. otherwise proceed to patch + gating.
